Why Ribble

Ribble is the first language-learning platform built entirely around the science of how we learn.

Every part of Ribble is designed around how your brain learns best — from encountering language in context to recalling, practicing, and reinforcing what you’ve learned.

Progress

Your consistency, made visible

A streak, a daily goal and every word you have mastered, laid out on one calm dashboard. The intensity grid fills in behind you as you keep showing up.

Free library

A free vocabulary library, sorted by your level

Every Ribble account comes with a free online library. Choose your language and level — French A1/A2 and up — then open any topic: Daily Life, Introducing Yourself, Daily Routine, Travel, Family, Food. Thousands of ready-made cards, no deck building required.

Dictionary

One word, every language you care about

Each entry opens with pronunciation, part of speech, a grammar note, translations, context sentences, synonyms and antonyms. Save it once and it lands in your deck.

Writing

Get corrected like a tutor would

Write in your target language and Ribble scores the attempt, highlights every mistake, shows the corrected text, then explains each fix in plain language.

Writing — grammar assistant

Your writing

yesterday i go to the market with my sister and we buys some bread it was very good

Analysing your sentence…

Writing score

71/100

Tense

i go→I went

Past narrative — use the simple past after “yesterday”.

Agreement

we buys→we bought

“We” takes the base form; here the past tense.

Punctuation

bread it was→bread. It was

Two independent clauses need a full stop.

✓ 3 corrections applied
